text: Handling deadlines is an important skill for students and workers. Good time management helps you plan your tasks and avoid stress. Start by making a schedule and breaking big projects into smaller steps. Prioritization is also key: decide which tasks are most important and do them first. Scope management means being realistic about what you can finish, so don't take on too much. Finally, communication matters. If you see a problem, tell your teacher or manager early. They can often help you find a solution. By following these simple ideas, you can meet deadlines more easily and feel more confident.
